title: POSCO Future M
summary: Korean maker of cathode and anode materials for batteries, backed by POSCO.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

POSCO Future M produces cathode and anode materials and refractory materials, with integrated access to POSCO's lithium and nickel investments. It is building cathode capacity in Korea and North America to serve US battery plants and local-content rules. Utilisation and customer qualification determine returns.

Technology Exposure

  • Cathode active materials
  • Anode materials
  • Refractories and industrial materials

What To Watch

  • Cathode plant ramp
  • US local-content rules
  • Lithium and nickel feedstock

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
